scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run test:reservation-guards && pnpm run test:reservation-validation && pnpm run test:deletion-guards && pnpm run test:storage-guide-document && pnpm run test:communications-readonly && pnpm run test:communications-integration && pnpm run test:offline-sync && pnpm run test:sheet-import-hardening && pnpm run test:sheet-import-duplicate-warning
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test
